messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] arg_refactor, not able to replicate with specifying seed
parts:
I see it.  If you explicitly set a seed then it doesn't actually get passed to the RNG, instead 0 gets called.  The resultant behavior is that if you set a seed you get consistent results everytime, they're just consistent with a seed of 0 instead of the seed you specified (which is why I never noticed it).

Fixed, will push after I validate the tests.
